meta.name: running-chaos-tests
meta.description:
Execute chaos engineering experiments to test system resilience.
Use when performing specialized testing.
Trigger with phrases like "run chaos tests", "test resilience", or "inject failures".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 注入故障验证系统韧性
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果上线前想验证系统容错能力
copy.tagline_en: Inject failures to verify system resilience
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to validate fault tolerance before launch

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能按混沌工程方法规划并执行故障注入实验（如网络延迟、服务崩溃、资源耗尽），监控系统反应，验证恢复情况，并输出实验日志、行为报告和整改清单。
howto.when: 当你说“run chaos tests”“test resilience”“inject failures”等短语，或要求进行专门测试（如混沌测试）时触发。

say.text: 帮我给数据库代理注入 500ms 延迟，然后跑一遍相关测试。
say.note: 将生成 toxiproxy 实验并执行

say.text: 杀掉一个 API 服务实例，观察系统能否在 30 秒内恢复。
say.note: 会先记录基线再执行杀实例

say.text: 写一个混沌实验定义文件，包含稳态假设和回滚策略。
say.note: 输出 YAML/JSON 实验定义

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can plan and execute chaos engineering experiments by injecting failures (e.g., network latency, service crashes, resource exhaustion), monitor system behavior, verify recovery, and produce experiment logs, behavior reports, and action items.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say phrases like "run chaos tests", "test resilience", or "inject failures", or ask for specialized testing such as chaos testing.

say_en.text: Add 500ms latency to the database proxy and run the related tests.
say_en.note: Creates and runs a toxiproxy experiment.

say_en.text: Kill one API instance and check if the system recovers within 30 seconds.
Write a chaos experiment definition with steady-state hypothesis and rollback.
